Maccabiah Preparations: January 2013 Update
RECORD NUMBERS! Thousands of young Jewish athletes from all over the globe will see their dream
of competing in a world-class event come true this July! Round-up of the latest entry form stage on
Dec 31 confirmed that Maccabiah 2013 in July will break all participation records, soaring to around
8500 athletes from over 71 countries. The final tally will be near or over 9000 athletes, very likely in
Delegations from 70 or even more countries in the largest international event ever staged in the
Jewish world and largest ever hosted in Israel. No less than 42 types of sport will be contested in 140
tournaments at over 85 venues all over the country.
PREPARING A WORLD-CLASS EVENT: Hotels hosting athletes and guests — 40 big establishments each
rated 4- or 5-stars — and all training facilities and competition venues have been inspected to meet
safety and security requirements, likewise numerous cultural event venues. All Maccabiah
Departments are swiftly approaching operational manpower levels; professional staff, Maccabiah
suppliers' personnel, and volunteers are entering training programs. Expansion and modernization to
state-of-the-art levels is swiftly competing at Teddy Stadium in Jerusalem, where the Opening
Ceremony will be held, likewise construction of the brand-new Ofer Stadium in Haifa for the Closing
Ceremony. Levels of support, cooperation and systems-integration with Israel's government, national
authorities, municipalities, the Police and security services are closer and better than ever.
VIP PROGRAM: A glorious summer awaits you, one you will remember all your life. You will see
thousands of Jewish athletes parade into a Jerusalem stadium, ranked in their Delegations flying the
flags of over 70 countries, the greatest celebration of the global fellowship and solidarity of the
Jewish People and the People of Israel. This July, share in the excitement and sheer exhilaration of
seeing our athletes go ever higher, faster and stronger. Maccabiah 2013 will show you our ancient
and new homeland; you will marvel at the sights, sounds and tastes, feel the heartbeat and discover
the special magic of a place where we all connect as mishpacha, members of the same family.
Your 2013 VIP Program is our way of saying thank you to our generous supporters for investing in the
Jewish Future, for gifting so many resources, time, talent and effort to make the dream come true for
so many thousands of young Jewish athletes. We've expanded the Official Program to a full week with
special events and exclusive tour programs from Wednesday July 17 through Tuesday July 23, based
in luxury Jerusalem hotels until Sunday 21, when we move to the finest establishments in Tel Aviv.
July 2013 Flights to Israel and Hotel bookings are quickly filling up,
so please make your travel arrangements now!
(1) If you have not yet registered for the Maccabiah 2013 VIP Program,
contact Danielle Kimchi , VIP Desk at Gil Travel
Tel 215.568.6655 x370 OR 800.223.3855 x370/
(2) Vered, Michal and Re'ut of Maccabiah VIP Department are already at your service!
As soon as you register the VIP department will email a questionnaire to you.
Together, we'll tailor your program to your personal requirements, and make all arrangements
at your request, including stays in Israel before and after the Official VIP Program.

ARRIVAL IN ISRAEL
July 16 Tuesday
Participants are earnestly requested to arrive in Israel at any time before or on this date,
and to check-in at your pre-arranged Hotel in Jerusalem; VIP Dept. staff will welcome you at
Ben Gurion Airport and at your Hotel.
July 17 - 20 HOSTED IN JERUSALEM
July 17 Wednesday
Morning: Israel Museum Tours expertly guided in person by Museum CEO James Snyder
and senior curators, through the world-famous Jewish Life Cycle and Eretz Yisrael
Archeology collections, the Synagogues, and including areas closed to the general public.
Evening: "Golden Jerusalem" Maccabiah VIP Event: With President Peres and Prime
Minister Netanyahu, we are the guests of Mayor Nir Barkat and the City of Jerusalem; a
splendid Dinner in the magnificent setting of the fabled David's Tower atop the
Century
walls of the Old City, with great cabaret performances by top-class artistes.

Ancient Modi'in; Maccabiah Riders will carry the Torch amidst the impressive roar of their
massed Harley-Davidson Bikes from Modi'in to various sites on its progress up to Jerusalem
for the Opening Ceremony.
